scope: Authored bounded action/object relations supplement existing completion and recipient scoring; no corpus or model assets changed.
Single confirmation context expands from two to four characters; an explicit longer context can outweigh broad habits from unrelated clauses.
Rename application branding, source namespace, service implementation, JNI symbols and helper references while preserving Android update identity.

clause_relations.source: Authored word categories, not measured corpus frequencies or a general grammar parser.
clause_relations.boundary_behavior: Additive across lattice token boundaries; punctuation and non-Han reset context. Longest object supersedes overlapping shorter objects. Bare one-character objects require a subject, classifier or action status anchor.

context_learning.compatibility: Existing one/two-character keys still work; unchanged files, no migration reset. Explicit negative weights retain their full effect.
context_learning.specific_context_priority: When a positive three/four-character context exists for the same code, positive candidates relying on shorter contexts are capped at min(2, weight/4). Unknown longer contexts fall back to established shorter habits.
context_learning.privacy: Local only; existing protected/password-field gates remain. Stores bounded short sequences, not full sentences.

controlled_test.name: ContextLearningTest.singleCorrectionsWithDifferentLongContextsGuideTheNextWholeDecode
controlled_test.before: One selected JUnit test against the pinned baseline fails: expected 你好, got 係好.
controlled_test.after: Passes within final full unit suite.
controlled_test.fixture: Equal-prior toy dictionary, same last two context characters 覺得, different three-character contexts 我覺得 / 你覺得 and unequal confirmation counts.
controlled_test.limits: Isolates interference between local contexts; not a real-chat accuracy measurement.

branding.why_legacy_identifiers_remain: Preserve in-place updates, persisted app data, selected IME and existing launcher shortcuts. Old baseline paths and historical evidence remain intentionally unchanged.
branding.jni_bindings: All six declaration/symbol names match the new namespace; library target and loadLibrary use cantonesemixeng_semantic.
branding.optional_semantic_runtime: Not built or exercised; default SEMANTIC_MODEL is false.

target_rank_changes.target: 嘢方法係攞到個信心呢

personal_learning_simulation.method: The same 32 known daily targets are explicitly confirmed using Single choices three times. Existing character/known-word history is shared within each arm. This is a simulation of known choices, not unseen-sentence generalization.
personal_learning_simulation.limits: Both versions already place all 32 confirmed targets first with contextual learning; no 32-to-32 accuracy improvement is claimed.

experiments_not_shipped.max_overlapping_phrase_bonus: Using only the maximum overlapping suffix did not improve validation top1 and reduced top5 from 174 to 173 and top20 from 195 to 194; existing summed phrase bonus retained.
experiments_not_shipped.unanchored_single_character_objects: Boosted an overlapping lexical fragment 日借款錯啊; bare one-character object scoring now requires an explicit anchor.
experiments_not_shipped.initial_weight_1_25: No validation target-count improvement. Final 2.5 weight and boundary safeguards were calibrated on validation/daily development cases; held-out cases were evaluated after freezing rules.

validation.build: testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleRelease passed on final source.
validation.final_optimization_equivalence: BitSet ending lookup produces byte-identical complete candidate outputs on all 240 validation cases compared with the evaluated scoring implementation.
validation.helper_checks: Modified Python scripts compile, shell helper syntax passes; semantic candidate-exporter JVM helper compiles with the new source namespace.

android_update.device: Android 12 / API 31 software emulator; not Fold7
android_update.cold_start_wait: am start -W reached renamed SettingsActivity but its 21-second UI wait timed out under software emulation; this is not a startup speed pass.

limits: 600 includes 240 development validation cases; fixed daily cases also informed calibration. Gains remain small and these sets are not a representative measurement of current HK chat.
Long cases are additional contiguous snippets from the same pinned corpus; overlap with shorter snippets is possible.
No new corpus, model training or evaluation sentences were added to production assets. Authored categories cannot resolve all incoherent combinations or figurative language.
Additional scoring adds work; host timings fluctuate and are not Android key-to-candidate latency. No physical Fold7 performance or UI validation.

Actual Android update/instrumentation checks used fixed-signed debug APKs. Final release signature, identity and assets were verified separately. Software-emulator system UI/launcher ANR prevented visual rendering acceptance.

reproduce.ranking: Compile tools/RankingEvaluation.java with javac -encoding UTF-8 -sourcepath app/src/main/java and run identical inputs/assets in separate baseline/final JVMs; use legacy namespace for pinned 0.6.38.
reproduce.learning: Compile tools/ContextLearningEvaluation.java with the actual corresponding engine and run tools/hk_daily_context_cases.tsv; confirms known targets three times.
reproduce.performance: Separate sequential Java 17 JVMs, -Xmx1g; SearchPerformanceEvaluation uses three warmup and nine measured passes per code.

performance.environment: Sequential desktop Java 17 JVMs, -Xmx1g, release assets; no concurrent emulator/evaluation/build during timed passes. Three warmup/nine measured passes per code.
performance.note: Initial pair showed substantial timing variation after the ending-lookup optimization. Repeated both arms sequentially without scoring changes to assess the unresolved runtime concern. Report both pairs; no Android latency or unchanged-speed claim. 48-code repeated hi is a stress case.
